description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer for a remote consulting engagement. The role focuses on maintaining and enhancing cloud-based applications, troubleshooting production issues, developing backend services, supporting frontend development, and collaborating on AWS deployments and operations.
Full Stack Engineer maintaining cloud applications, developing Python or Node.js backends and React/TypeScript frontends, and building APIs

Responsibilities:
• Maintain, improve, and support existing cloud-based applications
• Troubleshoot software bugs, implement fixes, and help maintain reliable production services
• Develop and maintain backend functionality using Python and/or Node.js
• Support frontend development using React and TypeScript
• Build, maintain, and support APIs and web applications
• Collaborate with DevOps engineers on deployments and application operations within AWS environments
• Identify technical issues, investigate root causes, and implement effective solutions

Requirements:
• Approximately 1–3 or more years of relevant software development experience
• Professional experience with one or more of the following technologies: Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or React
• Experience building or maintaining APIs and web applications
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills
• Ability to collaborate with technical teams and contribute to application development and maintenance
• U.S. citizenship and current U.S. residency
